name: Tiny Viper Snake
appearance: The portrait shows a slender pale tan viper with a row of brown blotches and a fine, tapering tail.

combat.attackOptions: Space 2½ ft. and reach 0 ft. Both the attack and full attack are one Bite with injury poison.

Special attack.name: Poison (Ex)
Special attack.effectNote: After a damaging bite, the target makes a Fortitude save immediately and again 1 minute later, even if the first save succeeds. Each failure deals 1d6 Constitution damage. The viper is immune to its own venom and to venom from others of its kind.

Trait.name: Scent (Ex)
Trait.effectNote: Detect creatures by smell within 30 ft., 60 ft. if the creature is upwind or 15 ft. if downwind. A move action reveals the direction. Within 5 ft., the viper can pinpoint the creature.

Trait.name: Snake skills
Trait.effectNote: The listed modifiers include racial bonuses of +4 to Hide, Listen and Spot and +8 to Balance and Climb. Use the higher of Strength and Dexterity for Climb. The viper can take 10 on Climb checks even when rushed or threatened.

Trait.name: Swim
Trait.effectNote: The listed Swim modifier includes a +8 racial bonus for hazards and special maneuvers. The viper can take 10 even when distracted or in danger, and can run in a straight line while swimming.

notes: Always neutral. Solitary. The SRD lists no advancement or level adjustment. The viper usually bites defensively and then retreats.
Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity on the Bite attack roll. The listed attack bonus already uses Dexterity.

Use initiative +3 and the listed Weapon Finesse feat for this SRD printing. The later Monster Manual errata makes Weapon Finesse a bonus feat and adds Improved Initiative. d20srd.org reflects those changes and gives initiative +7.
With 0 ft. of reach, the viper must enter the target’s space to bite.
